candidate.professional_summary: Electrical engineer with experience in engineering, construction, commissioning, start-up and project management across power generation, transmission and distribution, industrial electrical plants, oil and gas, chemical, mining, and water treatment.
seniority_indicators: Technical presentation and technical enquiry coordination

education.source_text: MSc in Electrical Engineering, Amir Kabir University of Technology

experience.title: Field E&I Engineer
responsibilities: Provided engineering support for construction, commissioning and start-up.
Identified design and construction non-conformances against project specifications and standards.
Performed testing, inspection and verification of electrical and instrumentation installations.
Supervised construction and commissioning activities using Bechtel procedures.
Managed turnover of process start-up systems.
Performed EEHA installation verification and supported material management and procurement.
achievements: Delivered four Turbine Inlet Air Chilling packages including 2 MW, 6.6 kV compressor motors, substations, air cooler fans, instrumentation, vendor PLC systems and plant control-system interfaces.
Resolved design non-conformances and technical problems to meet project schedule.
Received Bechtel Leader+ recognition for quality and schedule performance.
experience.source_text: Engineering support for construction, commissioning and start-up; delivered four TIAC packages.

experience.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
responsibilities: Performed detail engineering from protection philosophy through electronic files, ITPs and commissioning support.
Acted as design manager during construction of a 25 kV traction substation.
Verified primary, secondary and civil submissions against standards and specifications.
Reviewed equipment data sheets, FAT, SAT and ITPs.
Verified interlocking philosophies and switching procedures.
Provided electrical and instrumentation detail design for a wastewater treatment facility.
Performed feasibility studies, substation design and network dynamic transient modelling.
achievements: Supported replacement of 48 2.4 kV switchgear units at the Canberra Deep Space Communication Complex.
Presented on IEC 61850 design changes at the GHD Global Technical Conference.
Supported design and construction of the Nowergup traction substation.
Completed a 20 MW IPCC feasibility study including MV VSD selection and ETAP modelling.
experience.source_text: Senior electrical engineering, design management and commissioning support across switchgear, traction substation, wastewater and mining projects.

experience.title: Senior Electrical Engineer / Power Delivery Service Line Coordinator
responsibilities: Coordinated technical enquiries for the Power Delivery service line.
Managed projects and performed protection engineering and construction/commissioning support.
Created protection philosophies, protection settings, logic diagrams, equipment data sheets and ITPs.
Verified electrical installations, closed punch items and prepared energisation and operating procedures.
Performed fault investigations, load shedding studies, earthing calculations, equipment audits and power-system studies.
Prepared and peer-reviewed electrical specifications, RFQs and tender evaluations.
Performed electrical detail design, cost estimating and construction support for mining and utility projects.
achievements: Managed protection engineering and site support for the 220/33 kV Sino Iron Port Substation, which was energised in May 2012.
Appointed Power Delivery Service Line Coordinator for the GHD WA operating centre.
Proposed revised Sepam relay settings and a solution for ferroresonance faults in a 6.6 kV system.
Performed transient stability analysis for starting a 13.5 MW Sag Mill.
Completed design for a 30 km 33 kV overhead power line and multiple mining and utility electrical projects.
experience.source_text: Power Delivery coordination, protection engineering, project management, power-system studies and mining/utility electrical design.

experience.title: Electrical Engineer
responsibilities: Designed and sized substation primary equipment, transformers, surge arresters and auxiliary systems.
Prepared protection and indication schedules, protection logic diagrams, SCADA I/O and control schematics.
Designed protection and control panel layouts, circuit diagrams and connection diagrams.
Designed AC/DC auxiliary supplies, lighting and power layouts.
Prepared inter-tripping and communication schemes between substations.
Reviewed outsourced designs and controlled major electrical equipment.
Provided construction and commissioning support.
achievements: Supported SCADA integration and protection upgrades at brownfield transmission and zone substations.
Supported detail design integration for greenfield substations including East Parramatta Switching Station and Penrith Transmission Substation.
experience.source_text: Substation design, protection and control, SCADA integration, equipment review, and construction/commissioning support.

experience.title: Senior Electrical Engineer
responsibilities: Prepared plant single-line diagrams, protection philosophies, logic diagrams, relay settings and metering/protection diagrams.
Performed cable routing and sizing, load-flow studies and short-circuit calculations.
Designed auxiliary systems, grounding systems, MV/LV switchgear protection and control.
Prepared emergency-system sizing for UPS, DC systems and diesel generators.
Prepared DCS I/O lists, hazardous-area studies, specifications, tenders and technical evaluations.
Provided construction and commissioning support.
achievements: Completed electrical detail design for Balance of Plants systems in four 250 MW Damavand combined-cycle power plant units.
Performed primary and secondary protection testing and FAT/SAT verification for transformers, MV switchgear, UPS and power cables.
Prepared electrical BOP specifications and tender documentation for four 250 MW Kerman CCPP.
experience.source_text: EPC electrical design and commissioning support for combined-cycle power plants.

experience.title: Electrical Engineer
responsibilities: Performed load-flow, short-circuit, protection and coordination studies using ETAP.
Verified FAT/SAT for MV and LV MCCs, switchgear, UPS, batteries and diesel generators.
Performed design review and verification of cathodic protection systems.
Designed auxiliary systems, lighting, lightning protection, distribution transformers, cable sizing and cable routes.
Verified earth-grid tests and hazardous-area classifications and inspections.
Performed SIL verification, intrinsically safe circuit calculations and instrument loop verification.
Participated in HAZOP meetings and supported cable installation, document control, material take-offs and tender reviews.
achievements: Provided detail design and construction/commissioning support for Train 1 and Train 2 of an Ethane/Propane Recovery Plant in Iran.
experience.source_text: Oil and gas EPC electrical engineering, hazardous-area verification, protection studies and commissioning support.
